name: Bedbug Reporting
description:
This dataset contains records of bedbug infestation filings for buildings, with 5,000 sampled rows and 21 columns. Each row represents a building-level filing and includes the building and registration identifiers, borough, address details (house number, street name, postcode), and the number of dwelling units in the building. Infestation-related fields capture the count of infested dwelling units, the number eradicated, and the number re-infested, along with the filing date and the start and end dates of the filing period. Geographic identifiers include latitude and longitude, community board, city council district, 2010 census tract, building identification number (BIN), borough-block-lot (BBL), and neighborhood tabulation area (NTA).

The data can be used to map and analyze the distribution of bedbug reports across neighborhoods and boroughs, compare infestation and eradication counts relative to building size, track re-infestation patterns, and examine reporting trends over time. It is also suitable for joining
